levels.name: Diagnostic Integrity
levels.purpose: Validate the diagnostics frame before trusting its output.

levels.name: Target Context
levels.purpose: Resolve target, runtime context, VCS state, paths and basic executability.

levels.name: Repository Inventory
levels.purpose: Collect bounded technology-neutral evidence about repository shape and capabilities.

levels.name: Repository Hygiene
levels.purpose: Detect repository-level integrity and hygiene hazards.

levels.name: Tooling Discovery
levels.purpose: Discover project manifests, automation surfaces and candidate tools without making them mandatory.

levels.name: Declared Validations
levels.purpose: Execute only validations explicitly declared by the local diagnostics configuration.

levels.name: Security Hygiene
levels.purpose: Perform bounded conservative hygiene checks without claiming a security audit.

levels.name: Kristal Manifest Integrity
levels.purpose: Validate schema manifest hashes/digests and release identity.

levels.name: Kristal Negative Release Gate
levels.purpose: Mutate critical release inputs and verify the release gate fails closed.

levels.name: Kristal Release Archive Reproducibility
levels.purpose: Build release archives repeatedly and test runtime-evidence isolation.

levels.name: Kristal Schema Negative Cases
levels.purpose: Verify required/schema-version negative mutations are rejected.

levels.name: Kristal JCS Fail-Closed
levels.purpose: Verify JCS vectors pass and tampered vectors/hashes fail.

levels.name: Kristal Conformance Coverage
levels.purpose: Assess executable coverage of normative EX/RP conformance requirements.

levels.name: Kristal Strict Docs Build
levels.purpose: Run mkdocs build --strict when the declared toolchain is available.

levels.name: Kristal Tool Consistency
levels.purpose: Ensure repository manifest tooling agrees with the authoritative release policy.

levels.name: Kristal v5 Normative Hygiene
levels.purpose: Detect stale major-version markers and release-status ambiguity in normative v5 validation documentation.

baseline.description: Universal read-oriented diagnostics with no target command execution.

deep.description: Maximum local Kristal validation: neutral diagnostics, native validators, fail-closed mutation tests, reproducibility and conformance coverage.
